summary: Iter 222 — Verified bug fix (NAME fallback) and enhancement (Cajas Asignadas/Pendientes + PVV Asignados/Pendientes) for the implementer workload tooltip on /projects. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass — shape/constraints, name-fallback equivalence vs user_id (Omar Jiménez: 12 proyectos, 70/70 cajas, 280/280 PVV, 4% avance), placeholder ids (_, none, null, undefined) all use the name fallback correctly, resilience to nonexistent ids returns 200 with zeros, and coverage check: EVERY one of the distinct implementers discovered from /api/projects + /api/projects/implementers/list returns 200 with valid metrics (cajas_pend ≤ cajas_asig, pvv_pend ≤ pvv_asig, 0 ≤ avance ≤ 100). Frontend: hover on implementer name opens HoverCard with 4 sections (Proyectos activos, Cajas Asig./Pend., PVV Asig./Pend., % Global de Avance with progress bar), fetches summary on open, closes cleanly on mouseleave, and 'Sin asignar' rows have no popover trigger.

design_issues.screen: Projects table (pre-existing, not introduced by this iteration)
issues: React hydration warnings caused by <span data-ve-dynamic='true' style='display:contents'> wrapper rendered as direct child of <tbody>/<tr> by external x-ve-dynamic instrumentation. Same noise reported in iter221; not caused by ImplementerWorkloadHover.

critical_code_review_comments: Bug fix correctly placed: implementer_workload_summary now does a 2nd lookup by assigned_to_name when user_id is empty/placeholder OR returns no projects — covers legacy/orphan projects whose assigned_to_user_id is missing or stale (which is exactly what produced the original 'para algunos implementadores no se puede ver el resumen').

Enhancement is consistent: cajas_pendientes = max(0, cajas_asignadas - cajas_configuradas) summed across active projects, same pattern as PVV. Confirmed via API: Omar -> cajas_asig 70 / cajas_pend 70 / pvv_asig 280 / pvv_pend 280 / 12 proyectos / 4% avance. Constraint pend ≤ asig holds for every implementer in DB.

Fixed a minor testid mismatch in ImplementerWorkloadHover.jsx: the spec required data-testid='workload-pvv-asignados' (masculine, to match JSON key pvv_asignados), but the DualMetric component was emitting 'workload-pvv-asignadas' (feminine) for both Cajas and PVV. Added an optional asignTestid prop and used it for PVV; Cajas testid unchanged. Pure attribute change, no behavior impact.
routes/projects.py is ~4088 lines — still exceeds the 700-line guideline (out of scope for this iteration, flagged again).

ImplementerWorkloadHover.jsx caches summary per row instance. With the name fallback now active, two different rows owned by the same implementer still each issue their own fetch. A module-level Map keyed by (userId||name) would dedupe across rows; minor perf nicety, not a bug.
